shortDescription: Manages load balancer listeners on the cloudscale.ch IaaS service

options.name: allowed_cidrs
options.description: Restrict the allowed source IPs for this listener. Empty means that any source IP is allowed. If the list is non-empty, traffic from source IPs not included is denied.

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for calls to the cloudscale.ch API. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TIMEOUT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: cloudscale.ch API token. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: api_url
options.description: cloudscale.ch API URL. This can also be passed in the C(CLOUDSCALE_API_URL) environment variable.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the load balancer listener. Either I(name) or I(uuid) are required.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol used for receiving traffic.

options.name: protocol_port
options.description: The port on which traffic is received.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the load balancer listener.

options.name: tags
options.description: Tags assosiated with the load balancer. Set this to C({}) to clear any tags.

options.name: timeout_member_connect_ms
options.description: Pool member connection timeout in milliseconds.

options.name: timeout_member_data_ms
options.description: Pool member inactivity timeout in milliseconds.

options.name: uuid
options.description: UUID of the load balancer listener. Either I(name) or I(uuid) are required.
